vmnet-helper upstream source snapshot

The bundled source is limited to the Meson build inputs needed by SongsterX:
the vmnet-helper program, its vmnet-broker client, build metadata, and the
upstream sudoers documentation. It is used to produce the bundled arm64
resource at src-tauri/resources/vmnet-helper.
